//: Claude adapter binding for the agent-agnostic VJS hook contract. cdd init installs generic scripts under .vjs/hooks/ and also copies them to .claude/hooks/ for this adapter. Claude fires UserPromptSubmit after prompt submission and before Claude processes it; Stop fires when Claude finishes responding. The Stop watchdog is inert unless .justice/ or Judicature/.justice/ exists and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, and it fails open. Set VJS_WATCHDOG_MODE=warn to make it advisory instead of blocking, or VJS_WATCHDOG=off to disable.
